research.basedefense.farmer_house.desc: A blueprint of a cozy house for your settlement's first villager. Place the house block on flat ground and in a few seconds a house with a garden appears, and a farmer moves in.
message.basedefense.research.done: %s researched "%s"! New recipe unlocked for everyone.
message.basedefense.research.locked: Research "%s" in the Base menu first
research.basedefense.rancher_house.desc: A sturdy dark-wood house with an animal pen. Place the block and in a few seconds a house with a pen, a water trough and hay appears, and a rancher moves in.
message.basedefense.base.already_exists: The server already has a Base (%s, %s, %s). You can't place a second one.
